subject.title: Feature: Global session reset on auth switch

question: Should OpenClaw support an administrator-authorized global auth refresh that preserves session context, and which active-session scopes and provider bindings must it cover?
rationale: The requested behavior adds a cross-session lifecycle and authorization contract; source evidence distinguishes it from existing single-session reset and auth-profile migration behavior, but cannot determine the intended permanent product semantics.

options.title: Approve a scoped global refresh
options.body: Define an admin-only refresh for active sessions that preserves session identifiers and transcript context while invalidating auth-backed runtime bindings.

options.title: Keep auth switching per session
options.body: Retain the current session-scoped reset model and document that operators must explicitly reset affected conversations.

options.title: Scope it to provider-switch recovery
options.body: Implement a narrower refresh only as part of an approved provider/auth migration workflow rather than exposing a general Gateway action.

recommendation.title: Approve a scoped global refresh
recommendation.body: Define an admin-only refresh for active sessions that preserves session identifiers and transcript context while invalidating auth-backed runtime bindings.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway session-reset history and the earlier issue review make this the strongest available routing candidate.
